_comment: Product feed validation rules consumed by scripts/validate_product_feed.py. Keys starting with '_' are human annotations and are SKIPPED by the script — never treat them as fields or rules.
_note: Edit required_fields / missing_tokens to match your catalog. Run: python3 scripts/validate_product_feed.py --feed your_feed.csv
description: Required-field + value-quality contract for an ecommerce product feed (CSV or JSON).

feed_format.csv: first row is the header; one product per data row
feed_format.json: either a JSON array of objects, or an object with a 'products' array
